equations_and_laws: For each compatible branch b, HI_b := (I_b, U_HU[b;eta2,eta1]). Application to an admissible perturbation is deltaX_out = U_HU[b;eta2,eta1] deltaX_in while I_b is carried unchanged as realized background context. No background matrix, coefficient rescaling, or reparameterization is introduced unless already present in an exact parent.

The physical perturbation modes/eigenstructure are exactly those of the frozen HU generator/propagator on V_b, now indexed by the compatible frozen I branch. HI introduces no new eigenvalue or mode selection.

The HU quotient V_b=ker(C_b)/im(G_b), constraint projector and G clock contract remain unchanged. I contributes its realized finite-relational geometry and constant graph-gauge quotient as background context; HI does not identify or mix distinct gauge directions beyond exact shared ancestry.

For perturbation covariance Sigma_delta on V_b, Sigma_delta,out = U_HU Sigma_delta,in U_HU^T. I background covariance Sigma_I remains attached unchanged. For any source-owned joint cross-covariance C_deltaI, the exact immutable product map gives C_out=U_HU C_deltaI and joint covariance [[U Sigma_delta U^T, U C],[C^T U^T, Sigma_I]]; HI neither sets unresolved cross-covariance to zero nor invents one.
Retain every parent-compatible branch. If exact parents do not select a unique branch, HI remains the complete lawful branch family.
Both parents inherit origin Big Implosion t_phys=0+ and unit family t_phys=t_B tau_B, t_B>0; therefore no new HI clock map is admitted.
